description: Monthly state-level electricity data from EIA. Filter by state (two-letter code or 'US' for national), sector (residential / commercial / industrial / transportation / all), and metric (price / sales / revenue / customers / generation). Default: US, all sectors, price.

end.description: Inclusive upper-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM).

start.description: Inclusive lower-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM depending on series cadence).

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. 'TX', 'CA') or 'US' for national rollup. Default 'US'.

name: eia_electricity_state
